import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Set style
sns.set_style("whitegrid")
plt.figure(figsize=(16, 12))

# Create subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(16, 12))

# 1. Sleep Duration vs Quality of Sleep by BMI Category
scatter = axes[0, 0].scatter(df['Sleep Duration'], df['Quality of Sleep'], 
                             c=df['Stress Level'], cmap='viridis', 
                             s=df['Physical Activity Level']/2, alpha=0.7)
axes[0, 0].set_xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 0].set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep (1-10)', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 0].set_title('Sleep Duration vs Quality by Stress Level\n(Size = Physical Activity)', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
cbar = plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=axes[0, 0])
cbar.set_label('Stress Level (1-10)', fontsize=10)

# 2. Distribution of Sleep Duration by Occupation (top 10)
top_occupations = df['Occupation'].value_counts().head(10).index
occupation_data = df[df['Occupation'].isin(top_occupations)]
sns.boxplot(data=occupation_data, x='Sleep Duration', y='Occupation', 
            ax=axes[0, 1], palette='Set2')
axes[0, 1].set_xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 1].set_ylabel('Occupation', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 1].set_title('Sleep Duration Distribution by Occupation (Top 10)', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')

# 3. Correlation heatmap of numerical variables
numerical_cols = ['Age', 'Sleep Duration', 'Quality of Sleep', 
                  'Physical Activity Level', 'Stress Level', 'Heart Rate', 'Daily Steps']
corr_matrix = df[numerical_cols].corr()
mask = np.triu(np.ones_like(corr_matrix, dtype=bool))
sns.heatmap(corr_matrix, mask=mask, annot=True, fmt='.2f', cmap='coolwarm',
            center=0, square=True, linewidths=1, cbar_kws={"shrink": 0.8},
            ax=axes[1, 0])
axes[1, 0].set_title('Correlation Matrix of Health Metrics', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')

# 4. Sleep metrics by BMI Category and Gender
bmi_order = ['Underweight', 'Normal', 'Overweight', 'Obese']
df['BMI Category'] = pd.Categorical(df['BMI Category'], categories=bmi_order, ordered=True)
bmi_gender_data = df.groupby(['BMI Category', 'Gender']).agg({
    'Sleep Duration': 'mean',
    'Quality of Sleep': 'mean',
    'Stress Level': 'mean'
}).reset_index()

x = np.arange(len(bmi_order))
width = 0.35
for i, gender in enumerate(['Male', 'Female']):
    gender_data = bmi_gender_data[bmi_gender_data['Gender'] == gender]
    axes[1, 1].bar(x + i*width - width/2, gender_data['Sleep Duration'], 
                   width, label=gender, alpha=0.8)
axes[1, 1].set_xlabel('BMI Category', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 1].set_ylabel('Average Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 1].set_title('Average Sleep Duration by BMI Category and Gender', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 1].set_xticks(x)
axes[1, 1].set_xticklabels(bmi_order)
axes[1, 1].legend(title='Gender')
axes[1, 1].grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# Adjust layout and save
plt.suptitle('Sleep Health & Lifestyle Analysis Dashboard', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
